question.problem:
Calculate $∇\times (F+G)$ at the point $(0,-1,1)$ for the vector fields $F$ and $G,$ where

$$
F(x,y,z)=\operatorname{sin}⁡x\,i+3z\,j-2y\,\text{k},\,(∇\times G)(x,y,z)=(6z-1)\,j.
$$
question.worked_solution:
If $F$ and $G$ are vector fields and $k$ is a constant, then we have the following linearity properties for curl:

- $∇\times (kF)=k∇\times F$

- $∇\times (F+G)=∇\times F+∇\times G$

First, we need to calculate $∇\times F.$ In doing so, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\times F & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ \frac{∂}{∂x} & \frac{∂}{∂y} & \frac{∂}{∂z} \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡x & 3z & -2y\end{aligned}| \\  & =[\frac{∂}{∂y}(-2y)-\frac{∂}{∂z}(3z)]i-[\frac{∂}{∂x}(-2y)-\frac{∂}{∂z}(\operatorname{sin}⁡x)]j+[\frac{∂}{∂x}(3z)-\frac{∂}{∂y}(\operatorname{sin}⁡x)]k \\  & =(-2-3)i-(0-0)j+(0-0)k \\  & =-5\,i.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the linearity properties, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\times (F+G) & =∇\times F+∇\times G \\  & =-5\,i+(6z-1)\,j.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, evaluating at the point $(0,-1,1),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}(∇\times (F+G))(0,-1,1) & =-5\,i+(6(1)-1)\,j \\  & =-5\,i+5\,j.\end{aligned}
$$
